title: Neurosurgeon burnt alive after car slams into divider, bursts into flames in Telangana
content: In a heartbreaking event, Dr K Jagadeesh Babu, a leading neurosurgeon from Khammam, died when his car collided with a road divider and caught fire on NH-365BB. The incident, occurring near Pillalamarri in Suryapet district early Sunday, raises concerns as police attribute the crash to possible drowsiness, resulting in this devastating loss for the medical community and his loved ones.

title: Shafali’s ton helps India crush Bangladesh, storm into Asian Games final
content: Shafali Verma’s historic 100 off 49 balls powered India Women to 195/4 before their bowlers bundled Bangladesh out for 81 in 15.4 overs, sealing a 114-run win in the Asian Games 2026 semi-final. India booked a place in the gold-medal match against Sri Lanka, while Shafali became the first player to score a century in women’s Asian Games cricket.

title: Friends thrash Thar driver, he rams SUV into their cab in Gurgaon
content: A quarrel among four men in Sector 89 escalated when one allegedly rammed his Thar into a Rapido cab carrying two of them, hitting it repeatedly. The three people inside the cab escaped unhurt, while police are tracing the men and verifying whether the Thar driver was intoxicated.

title: Dilpreet's four-goal show headlines India's 13-1 rout of Indonesia at Asian Games
content: Defending champions India began their Asian Games men's hockey campaign in emphatic fashion, thrashing Indonesia 13-1 in their opening Pool A match. Dilpreet Singh led the rout with four goals, while Shilanand Lakra and Sukhjeet Singh scored twice each. India will next face Sri Lanka on Tuesday as they begin their title defence.

title: Google's former CEO Eric Schmidt warns: Within 5 years, AI could …
content: Eric Schmidt, the former CEO of Google, envisions a future where sophisticated AI systems tackle intricate tasks by utilizing extended context windows and cooperative AI agents. These agents are expected to develop specialties and potentially their own languages. Furthermore, the evolution of text-to-software capabilities marks a significant enhancement in AI functionality, raising concerns that humans might ultimately lose insight into the complex operations of such powerful AI.

title: India's defence industry takes off: The numbers explained
content: India's defence manufacturing sector has transformed over the past decade, moving from heavy import dependence toward genuine domestic capability. Production hit a record Rs 1.78 lakh crore in 2025-26, more than double 2020-21 levels, against a Rs 3 lakh crore target by 2029, backed by a defence budget that has tripled since 2013-14. Exports are the standout metric, up 56-fold to a record Rs 38,424 crore, reaching 80+ countries, with private industry now contributing 45.16% of exports and a record 24% of production, a major structural shift from PSU dominance.

title: North Korea fires ballistic missile amid rising regional tensions
content: In a provocative move, North Korea fired a ballistic missile from its eastern shores into the sea, escalating already heightened military tensions. This launch coincides with recent missile and drone drills conducted by Pyongyang. The situation has deteriorated following joint military exercises between South Korea, the US, and Japan, prompting North Korea to signal potential countermeasures against these perceived threats.

title: WWII pilot vanished over Egypt in 1942; family buries him 84 years later
content: After eight long decades, Captain Marvin Lancaster was laid to rest in North Carolina. His fighter plane was shot down over Egypt during WWII in 1942, and for years, his identity remained a mystery. Thanks to advanced DNA matching, his family finally received closure, gathering to remember his bravery and sacrifice on National POW MIA Recognition Day, a day dedicated to honoring the missing servicemen and women.

title: West Virginia eighth-grader builds low-cost 3D-printed bionic hand
content: Kianoosh Nawai, an eighth-grader from West Virginia Virtual Academy, has been selected as the state’s only finalist in the 2026 Thermo Fisher Scientific Junior Innovators Challenge. He designed and built a low-cost 3D-printed prosthetic hand, testing its grip strength and finger movement. His project was selected from nearly 2,000 entrants and will compete against 29 other finalists in Washington, DC.

title: Fake Insta account, ‘Operation Honeymoon’: How Siya Goyal plotted fiancé's murder
content: Siya Goyal and Chetan Chaudhary allegedly used a fake social media account to lure her fiancé Ketan Agarwal.  The trio studied a past case and films before planning the businessman's murder.  They identified Lohagad Fort as a suitable location for the fatal fall.  The plan was executed on June 18, leading to Ketan's death in a gorge.  Police filed a comprehensive chargesheet based on extensive digital and forensic evidence.

title: Yudh Abhyas 2026: M777 howitzers roar as Indian, US forces showcase firepower in Rajasthan
content: During Exercise Yudh Abhyas 2026, Indian and US Army personnel showcased the impressive capabilities of the M777 howitzer. Gun crews highlighted its firepower and coordinated operations, while US troops shared valuable insights with Indian battery teams. This live demonstration, paired with a comprehensive lecture on tactical deployment, aims to boost interoperability and enhance military readiness in challenging mountainous environments.

title: CCTV shows BMW crashing through barrier, falling off Mumbai Coastal Road bridge; 3 dead
content: In a devastating early morning crash, a speeding BMW plunged off Mumbai's Coastal Road bridge. This unfortunate event occurred at a construction site, resulting from the driver's loss of control. Three lives were claimed in the accident, with Shanay Gajjal and Dhirya Seth identified among the deceased; the third passenger’s identity remains unknown. Meanwhile, one individual is critically injured, leading authorities to start a thorough investigation into the circumstances.

title: 'Torture, caste discrimination': IIT-Bombay student’s father seeks justice
content: Seeking justice, the father of a deceased IIT-Bombay student alleges that systemic torture and caste discrimination were catalysts for his son's suicide. In turn, authorities have opened an abetment of suicide case, applying the SC/ST Act, naming a senior professor and others in the complaint. The institution, however, denies these allegations, claiming full support for the ongoing inquiry.

title: Asian Games: MMA's Varun Sanyal medically unfit after dizziness during weight cut
content: Indian MMA fighter Varun Sanyal withdrew from the Asian Games after a medical issue. He experienced dizziness and muscle cramps during a weight cut sauna session. Sanyal, a medal prospect, was declared medically unfit for the competition. His teammate Suchika Tariyal advanced in her event, securing a medal. MMA's debut at the Asian Games faces challenges for Indian athletes.

title: Delhi pollution crackdown: Hotspots to be mapped, road works get Oct 31 deadline
content: In a concerted effort to tackle air pollution, the Delhi government is enhancing its oversight of environmental quality. District officials will create maps highlighting pollution hotspots and will identify nearby contributors to the problem. Agencies are tasked with implementing strategies and timelines for effective pollution management, with a deadline for finishing pending road and civil works set for October thirty-first.

title: China leads, US ranks 27th: Top 15 countries with highest math scores
content: China has recorded the highest mathematics score among 91 countries and economies in the latest global student assessment, with 612 points. Singapore, Macao and Chinese Taipei follow in the top four. The United States ranks 27th with 463 points, while Canada stands 11th. East Asian education systems dominate the rankings.

title: Uday Kotak: ‘Indians and their gold is a puzzle we must solve’
content: "Indians and their gold - that is a puzzle we have to find a way to solve," he said. Kotak suggested that a committee could be considered to work out a solution that takes into account people's requirements while also addressing the country's capital and current account challenges.

title: Ed Sheeran's Macklemore controversy sparks mixed reactions
content: Ed Sheeran addressed the Macklemore controversy and the Israel-Palestine conflict during his Philadelphia concert. He acknowledged making mistakes and spoke about free speech and the humanitarian issue. His comments generated divided opinions among fans and social media users. Some defended his stance while others questioned his approach to the situation. Sheeran expressed his heartbreak over the devastation and loss of civilian lives.

title: Second medal for India, Elavenil wins silver in women’s 10m air rifle at Asiad 2026
content: Elavenil Valarivan narrowly missed gold in the women’s 10m air rifle final at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games, settling for silver with 252.4 points. Japan’s Taichi Hinata won gold with 253.0, while South Korea’s Ban Hyojin took bronze. Elavenil had earlier helped India win team silver, adding a second medal to the country’s shooting haul.

title: At 12, she was eve-teased: Suchika is now India’s first Asian Games MMA medallist
content: Eve-teased at 12, Suchika Tariyal took up judo for self-defence, beginning a journey through judo, Ju-Jitsu and MMA. At 36, the Rohtak fighter became India’s first Asian Games MMA medallist after beating Mongolia’s Altanchimeg Baigalmaa 2-0 to reach the -60kg semifinals. A former eight-time national judo champion, Tariyal now hopes her journey inspires more young women.

title: 'Tell us where to come, schools fixed before our visit': CJP mocks Rajasthan govt
content: Mentioning the Ranka's post, another CJP member Sourav Das quipped: "People of Rajasthan, tell us where you want us to come. Government is releasing and fixing places before our visit!" Last month, Ranka alleged that Rajasthan Police was keeping a watch on people entering and leaving his house, hours after the organisation’s team faced a confrontation during its campaign to inspect government schools.

title: Watch: Smoke over Riyadh airport after Houthi's major attack on Saudi Arabia
content: On Saturday, Houthi rebels executed a large-scale offensive against Saudi Arabia, causing tremors in the capital, Riyadh, where explosions reverberated. Flight operations at the nearby airport faced delays as Saudi air defenses successfully intercepted a ballistic missile aimed at the city. The Houthis boasted of striking key strategic targets, including an Aramco facility, marking a pronounced escalation in the ongoing regional strife.

title: India open Asian Games shooting campaign with silver in women's 10m air rifle
content: The Indian shooting team kicked off their Asian Games journey by clinching a silver medal, thanks to the impressive efforts of Elavenil Valarivan, Sonam Maskar, and Vidarsa Vinod. Both Elavenil and Sonam made it to the final of the individual 10m air rifle competition. Building on their previous success in Hangzhou, the team is eager for more medal opportunities in the upcoming events.

title: Home guard slaps and drags woman by hair, arrested in Hyderabad
content: A home guard was terminated and arrested for assaulting a woman near Hafeezpet railway station, with the entire episode captured on video. Cyberabad police commissioner Ramesh acted swiftly, ordering the termination and the registration of a criminal case. Following the footage’s release, Director General of Police CV Anand emphasized a zero-tolerance policy towards crimes against women.

title: Cough syrups still being given to very young children; red warning for under-4s proposed
content: The proposed changes include a visual showing school-age children on the packaging, intended to make it clear that the medicine is meant for older children rather than infants and toddlers.

title: Who is Nila Vikhe Patil, Maharashtra-origin leader elected to Sweden Parliament?
content: Nila Vikhe Patil, from a prominent Indian political family, has been elected to Sweden's Parliament. She will represent the Green Party in the 349-seat Riksdag after years of dedicated party work. Patil's career includes roles in the Swedish Prime Minister's office and municipal governance. Her education in economics and law shaped her focus on finance and taxation portfolios.

title: 'Negotiate or face decisive war': Iran sets 7 conditions to restart talks with US
content: Iran has officially presented seven demands to Washington for resuming negotiations, emphasizing the need to conclude hostilities and unfreeze assets. Alongside this diplomatic approach, Iran is readying itself for potential US military actions, adapting its military strategy to prioritize naval capabilities. Efforts are underway to swiftly resolve the ongoing conflict.

title: ‘Sell your wife’: Delhi's killer couple who murdered executive face fraud probe

An FIR details how the duo allegedly duped a senior executive of over Rs 1.2 crore using fake government notices, while investigators examine their movements and electronic devices.

title: Numbers behind DUSU result: CJP momentum doesn’t show up in Left’s vote tally
content: The DUSU election results highlighted a contest that extended beyond the traditional ABVP NSUI binary, with Independent Deepanshu Shokeen’s decisive vice presidential victory and close races in the presidential and joint secretary contests. The results also showed a decline in the AISA SFI alliance’s vote tally despite its prominent participation in CJP mobilisations and campaigns around student issues such as housing, examinations and accountability.

title: Turkey offers support to Saudi military as Houthi attacks test new defence pact
content: Amid rising Houthi threats, Turkey extends military aid to Saudi Arabia, potentially putting the new Saudi-Turkey-Pakistan defense agreement to the test. This pact ensures collective defense among member nations under attack. However, Pakistan has confirmed that there are no immediate plans for military action. Additionally, Saudi Arabia is pursuing military support from the US to counter the Houthis’ aggression.

title: J&K: Fire damages Mata Vaishno Devi helipad terminal in Reasi
content: the fire started around 3:15 am, apparently due to a short circuit . the helipad terminal, an important transit point for pilgrims travelling to the shrine atop the Trikuta hills, was closed at the time of the incident . no casualties have been reported .

title: Strong 6.1-magnitude earthquake strikes Papua New Guinea region
content:
Earthquake strikes Papua New Guinea (Reuters photo)

An earthquake of magnitude 6.12 struck the Papua New Guinea region on Sunday, the German Research Center for Geosciences (GFZ) said. The earthquake occurred at a depth of 114 km (70.84 miles), according to GFZ. There is no immediate reports of casualties and damage.

title: As monsoon withdrawal begins, season may end with 10% deficit
content: the monsoon has reported a nationwide deficit of 15% in cumulative rainfall . the line of withdrawal from west Rajasthan passed through Ramgarh, Mohangarh, Phalodi and Khajuwala . as many as 14 states, including Bihar, Punjab, Haryana and all five peninsular states, have reported an overall rain deficit of more than 20% so far .
